name: Introduction to Computational Materials Science
summary: Introduces modelling across length and time scales and the numerical methods that let materials scientists simulate diffusion, heat flow and structure.

topics.name: The multiscale landscape: electrons, atoms, microstructure and continuum
Scientific programming for materials (Python, NumPy, visualisation)
Finite-difference solutions of diffusion and heat-flow problems
Introduction to finite element analysis for materials problems
Random numbers and Monte Carlo sampling
Structure generation and visualisation (supercells, defects, OVITO/VESTA)
Verification, validation and uncertainty in simulation
Materials databases and open data (Materials Project, AFLOW, OQMD)
Workflow tools and high-performance computing basics
